title: MichaudLab/pacbio_postprocessing pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

inputsJSON.errorMessage: Path to the analysis input JSON summary must be provided

outputJSON.errorMessage: Path to the analysis output JSON summary must be provided

shortreadsGVCF.errorMessage: Path to the shortread gvcf file of the sample (generally in Narval under ~/projects/ctb-rallard/COMMUN/PRAGMatIQ-EMG/archives/.../[name].dragen.hardfiltered.gvcf.gz)

bamHaplotagged.errorMessage: Path to the happlotagged BAM file of the sample (generally in the S3-Storage folder)

group.errorMessage: Select one of the four geneYX groups: validation, prag (pragmatiq) decode (Decodeur) or controle
